purpose.en: Adopt the proven SmartClass hamburger interaction on greatlovemeta.com before and after login, with the common twelve text-only language choices on desktop and mobile.
purpose.zh: 在 greatlovemeta.com 登录前后采用已验证的 SmartClass 汉堡菜单交互，并在桌面和移动端提供共同的 12 种纯文字语言选项。

en: One dark hamburger control changes into a close icon.
The full-width mobile drawer combines navigation, language, and account actions.
Anonymous visitors see Sign in or register; members see account navigation.
Desktop and mobile share one ordered twelve-language text list.
zh: 一个深色汉堡按钮在打开后变为关闭图标。
全宽移动抽屉统一包含导航、语言和账户操作。
匿名访客看到“登录或注册”，会员看到账户导航。
桌面和移动端共用同一组有序的 12 语言纯文字列表。

en: Replace the legacy narrow details menu with an accessible state-driven drawer.
Preserve the site-local brand and route map.
Store all twelve language preferences; existing bilingual content uses the documented English fallback for untranslated locales.
Add a regression contract for menu, account, and language behavior.
zh: 以具备无障碍状态的抽屉替换旧窄幅 details 菜单。
保留本站独立品牌和路由。
保存全部 12 种语言偏好；现有双语内容对尚未翻译的语言使用已注明的英文回退。
新增菜单、账户和语言行为回归门禁。

en: Production build and Sites artifact validation passed.
Header contract verified the SmartClass drawer, both account states, and twelve text-only languages.
Responsive CSS prevents separate desktop controls and horizontal overflow in mobile mode.
zh: 生产构建和 Sites 部署产物校验通过。
页眉契约已验证 SmartClass 抽屉、两种账户状态和 12 种纯文字语言。
响应式样式在移动模式隐藏独立桌面控件并防止横向溢出。

en: Full native translation beyond the site's existing localized content remains content work; untranslated selections fail safely to English instead of presenting mixed or fabricated translations.
zh: 超出本站现有本地化内容的完整母语翻译仍属于后续内容工作；尚未翻译的选择安全回退为英文，不呈现混杂或虚构译文。

en: Keep greatlovemeta.com identity, data, configuration, routes, and deployment resources independent.
zh: 保持 greatlovemeta.com 的身份、数据、配置、路由和部署资源完全独立。
